snippet.title: Lord Huron - The Night We Met (Lyrics)
snippet.description:
lord huron - the night we met

thank you for spending a moment here with us. 
we hope the music brought you a little comfort.

feel free to subscribe if you felt the warmth of the music 🌟

· follow Lord Huron:
spotify: https://open.spotify.com/artist/6ltzsmQQbmdoHHbLZ4ZN25?si=25dea10644a5491e
apple music: https://music.apple.com/us/artist/lord-huron/393068687

lyrics:
[intro]
(ooh, ooh, ooh)
(ooh, ooh, ooh)
(ooh, ooh, ooh)
(ooh, ooh, ooh)

[verse 1]
i am not the only traveler
who has not repaid his debt
i've been searching for a trail to follow again
take me back to the night we met
and then i can tell myself
what the hell i'm supposed to do
and then i can tell myself
not to ride along with you

[chorus]
i had all and then most of you
some and now none of you
take me back to the night we met
i don't know what i'm supposed to do
haunted by the ghost of you
oh, take me back to the night we met

[verse 2]
when the night was full of terrors
and your eyes were filled with tears
when you had not touched me yet
oh, take me back to the night we met

[chorus]
i had all and then most of you
some and now none of you
take me back to the night we met
i don't know what i'm supposed to do
haunted by the ghost of you
take me back to the night we met

#lordhuron #thenightwemet

It’s unique in that practically everything on ROBLOX is designed and constructed by members of the community. ROBLOX is designed for 13 to 18 year olds, but it is open to people of all ages. Each player starts by choosing an avatar and giving it an identity. They can then explore ROBLOX — interacting with others by chatting, playing games, or collaborating on creative projects. Each player is also given their own piece of undeveloped real estate along with a virtual toolbox with which to design and build anything — be it a navigable skyscraper, a working helicopter, a giant pinball machine, a multiplayer “Capture the Flag” game or some other, yet-to-be-dreamed-up creation. There is no cost for this first plot of virtual land. By participating and by building cool stuff, ROBLOX members can earn specialty badges as well as ROBLOX dollars (“Robux”). In turn, they can shop the online catalog to purchase avatar clothing and accessories as well as premium building materials, interactive components, and working mechanisms.

- Sam and Alice for their cameos and assistance during the 'Keyring Key Keyring' segment and 'I Live in the Bin' song segment......
- Chris Johnson for his voice cameo as 'The Boo-t' (https://bsky.app/profile/officialcdj.bsky.social)......


All stock images provided by Shutterstock and all stock sounds and music provided by Epidemic Sound. 'Nick on Sunset' footage found here: https://youtu.be/TB_wCqreisk?si=Ph2lOQjwHYzzsJ2n 


Oh no it's Rugrats. By Nickelodeon. Ever since Rugrats Search for Reptar PS1 and Caddy having his Rugrats Search for Reptar review from all those years ago, Caddicarus has wanted to talk about all of the Rugrats games available from Nickelodeon and their own Nickelodeon games, or as some would call them, Nick games, but I don't know who Nick is. The first Nickelodeon game that Caddicarus made a video about all those years ago during the retro reviews era was actually Rugrats Totally Angelica PS1, better known as Rugrats Totally Fanny as per the original title of the Totally Angelica review. Caddy no longer does game reviews and stopped doing the basic ideas of his regular review show many years ago, in fact he hasn't done a game review in over 5 years now, let alone a game review of a Rugrats review. But now, in his current style, Jim will look at as many Rugrats PS1 games he can stomach while making as many jokes and out of context moments as possible, all the while never answering the question if one Rugrats game or another is actually good or bad, because who cares. Chuckie definitely doesn't, nor does Chuckie Rugrats. Tommy Pickles also doesn't care, because he's Tommy Pickles Rugrats starring in his own bad PS1 games. But didn't I just say that Jim or Caddy won't be actually saying if the video games like Rugrats Studio Tour PS1 are actually bad games or even bad PlayStation games as a whole? Yes I did, so don't expect to see bad PS1 games - just get ready to see Studio Tour and Search for Reptar and even Rugrats in Paris PS1 - but not Rugrats in Paris trailer or Rugrats in Paris clips because that's not legal. There's actually a lot of Rugrats PS1 games that you probably don't know about, even if you do know all of the classic Rugrats music and Rugrats theme that appear in all of the PS1 games, more accurately the Rugrats Search for Reptar soundtrack or Search for Reptar OST. Caddy is looking at every PS1 game the Rugrats themselves starred in which is a surprising 6 titles, not just including Studio Tour PS1 and all the other Phil and Lil or Angelica video games mentioned earlier. There's also Nicktoons Racing PS1 from all of the classic Nicktoons in the 90s with 90s Nickelodeon and 90s Nicktoons, featuring Ren and Stimpy, The Wild Thornberries and even AAH Real Monsters which I never saw. On top of Nicktoons Racing game and not the new Nicktoons kart racer on PS5 and Switch called Nickelodeon Kart Racers review and Nickelodeon Kart Racers gameplay, there's also Rocket Power PS1 from the Rocket Power Nickelodeon show featuring the Rocket Power intro, much like the classic Rugrats intro from the original Rugrats opening and not the Rugrats reboot intro - not the Rugrats new series with Dil Pickles who was in the Rugrats the Movie and Rugrats the Movie trailer, but the new Rugrats Paramount Plus that nobody likes. Rocket Power Team Rocket Rescue PS1 is one thing, but who else remembers All Grown Up intro?

G2 stands in the middle, ready to prove they still belong among the elite.Group Omega is shaped by pressure. NRG stand as the favorites, but KRÜ arrive ready to fight, and Envy reenters the spotlight with legendary names looking to prove they can still compete.

There is no cost for this first plot of virtual land. By participating and by building cool stuff, ROBLOX members can earn specialty badges as well as ROBLOX dollars (“Robux”). In turn, they can shop the online catalog to purchase avatar clothing and accessories as well as premium building materials, interactive components, and working mechanisms.

snippet.title: Can I Go From a PEASANT To a KNIGHT In Bannerlord WARHAMMER Mod?
snippet.description:
Today, I will go from a peasant to a knight in the bannerlord warhammer mod, the old realms. I will be joining the faction of Bretonnia, a kingdom built on honor, chivalry, and endless war. Starting with nothing but torn clothes and a rusty weapon, I’ll have to survive brutal battles, earn the favor of nobles, build my reputation, and prove myself worthy of knighthood in the war-torn world of Warhammer Fantasy.

Will I survive long enough to claim my title, or die forgotten on the battlefield?




Chapters:


0:00 Intro
1:09 the plan
1:52 The Soldier Arc
18:15 Starting my own Knighthood Order



Mount & Blade II: Bannerlord is a strategy action role-playing video game developed and published by TaleWorlds Entertainment. It is a prequel to Mount & Blade: Warband, a stand-alone expansion for the 2008 game Mount & Blade. Bannerlord takes place 210 years before its predecessor, with a setting inspired by the Migration Period.
Mount & Blade II: Bannerlord is a strategy/action role-playing game. The fundamental gameplay premise is the same as previous entries in the series: the player builds up a party of soldiers and performs quests on an overhead campaign map, with battles being played out on battlefields that allow the player to personally engage in combat alongside their troops.

snippet.title: CUTTING THE BEAUTIFUL LUSH ALFALFA | Witcombe Park Farm Farming Simulator 25 - Episode 9
snippet.description:
Welcome to Witcombe Park Farm by oxygendavid!

Mod List
Witcombe Park Farm - https://shorturl.at/AQYe9
MF8200 - https://www.farming-simulator.com/mod.php?mod_id=355326&title=fs2025
Quadro Pro Baler Pack - https://www.farming-simulator.com/mod.php?mod_id=334468&title=fs2025
590t - https://www.kingmods.net/en/fs25/mods/68481/massey-ferguson-590


Info about the map written by oxygendavid
Welcome to Witcombe Park Farm
📍 Inspired by the countryside of Gloucestershire, UK

🌄 A carefully crafted blend of real‑world geography and fictional design, creating a distinctive and authentic UK farming landscape.
🚜 60+ fields ranging from small paddocks to large arable expanses.
🗺️ 100+ purchasable farmlands, including extensive forestry plots and hidden woodland corners.
🐇 New animal: Rabbits
🐖🐄🐑 New British livestock breeds, each with their own stats: • Gloucestershire Old Spot (pigs) • Hereford & Jersey (cattle) • Suffolk, Bluefaced Leicester & Texel (sheep)
🌦️ Fully reworked environment XML featuring new weather patterns, lighting profiles, cloud systems, and a refreshed daytime skybox.
🌱 Completely redesigned UK style ground textures and foliage, giving the map a fresh, grounded visual identity. 🚂 Driveable Class 40 (UK) 🇬🇧 Step into the cab of a fully driveable British Rail Class 40 and experience true UK diesel‑electric power in action! 🔧⚡
Fire up the engine, take the controls, and enjoy driving one of Britain’s most iconic locomotives right inside the game. 🚆✨ Who’s taking it for a spin first 😄
🌲 High detail forest assets for a more realistic woodland experience.
🎧 Custom ambient soundscape tailored to the map’s environment.
🚗 New UK‑style traffic, including motorbikes, tractors, and articulated lorries.
🏡 4 fully developed main farms, each with their own character.
🏘️ 4+ small holdings, offering varied and immersive starting points.
🛠️ Full customization sellable farm buildings, removable junk piles, adjustable field borders, and more.
🎮 Designed to support every playstyle  from small scale realism to large scale contracting.

Multi Terrain Angle added 
🌾 14 New Crops Added 
📦 From PfalzAgrar Multi Prefab Pack (10):
Rye • Triticale • Spelt • Grain Maize • Green Rye • Vetch Rye • Field Grass • Silage Maize • Humus Activator • Mustard

🌼 Custom Crops (3):
Alfalfa • Linseed • Poppy

🏭 7 custom production chains integrated seamlessly into the map.
🍎 4 dedicated fruit sell points
🏪 10 additional sell points for productions, materials, and goods.
🧱 30+ new UK‑themed placeables
🏘️ Hundreds of high‑detail UK assets populating the world.


Music by Epidemic Sound
